technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum with strong confluence on 9/21 EMA cross and Ichimoku signals, but weak trend structure (low ADX), overbought conditions, and price below 200-EMA limit conviction for swing entry.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis regime (372.16) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates highly unfavourable conditions; earnings in 68 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum confluence (9/21 EMA cross, Ichimoku tk-cross, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 61.08.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 372, negative yield curve, unfavourable macro score -3), overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), price below 200-EMA and 50-SMA, weak ADX trend strength, below-average volume, and high earnings risk within 68 days overwhelm technical setup.
